title: Jubilees 12 — Abram's iconoclasm, the burning of the idol-house, and the call out of Ur

paragraphs.text: ወኮነ፡ በሳድስ፡ ሰሙን፡ በሳብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ይቤሎ፡ አብራም፡ ለታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፡ አባ፡

i18n.en: And it came to pass in the sixth week, in the seventh year of it, that Abram said to Terah his father, saying: Father.

paragraphs.text: ምንተ፡ ረዳኤ፡ ወክብር፡ ቦቱ፡ እምነ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ጣዖታት፡ ዘአንተ፡ ትትፈቅሩ፡ ወትሰግዱ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡

i18n.en: What help and profit have we from these idols which you worship, and before which you bow yourselves?

paragraphs.text: እስመ፡ አልቦ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቦቱ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ጽሙማን፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወአቡሰናተ፡ ልብ፡ ወምንተኒ፡ ይክሉ፡ ገቢረ፡ ለርእስ፡ ሎሙ፡

i18n.en: For there is no spirit in them, for they are mute forms, and a delusion of the heart; and they can do nothing for themselves.

paragraphs.text: እሙንቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ሎሙ፡ ግዕዘ፡ ስሕተት፡ ለልብክሙ፡ ኢትስግዱ፡ ሎሙ፡ አላ፡ ስግዱ፡ ለፈጣሬ፡ ኵሉ፡ ለዘ፡ ፈጠረ፡ ሰማየ፡ ወምድረ፡ ወአፍላገ፡ ወዘፈጠረ፡ ሰብአ፡ ወአስተአተተ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡

i18n.en: Worship not them, but bow yourselves to the God of heaven who causes the rain and the dew to descend on the earth, and does everything upon the earth, and has created everything by his word, and all life is from before his face.

paragraphs.text: ወያአምር፡ አቡየ፡ አምላከ፡ ሕይወት፡ ዘይቤሎ፡ ኢኒሁ፡ ኦ፡ ወልድየ፡ አንሰ፡ የአምር፡ ወምንተ፡ እትገበር፡ ለሕዝብየ፡ ዘይተአዘዙ፡ ሊተ፡ ለመጠን፡ አንሰ፡ ኬብር፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡

i18n.en: Why do you worship things that have no spirit in them? For they are the work of men's hands, and on your shoulders you bear them; and you have no help from them — but they are a great cause of shame to those who make them, and a delusion of the heart to those who worship them. Worship them not.

paragraphs.text: ወቅንዓ፡ ጥቀ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኢትንግር፡ እምነዝ፡ ቃል፡ ለመነኒ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይቅትሉነ፡

i18n.en: And his father said to him: I also know it, my son; but what shall I do with a people who have made me serve before them? And if I tell them the truth, they will slay me — for their soul cleaves to them, to worship them and to honor them. Hold your peace, my son, lest they slay you.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤሎ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ኦ፡ አባ፡ አንሰ፡ እነግር፡ በ፪ አኀዊየ፡ እምነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ቃል፡

i18n.en: And he spoke these words to his two brothers, and they were angry with him; and he held his peace.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤሎ፡ ኢትንግር፡ ለሎሙ፡ እምነ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ቃል፡ እስመ፡ ይሰምዑ፡ መንፈሶሙ፡ ኪያየ፡ ወያኦፍዑ፡ ኪያነ፡ ለዘ፡ ይትፀለሉ፡ ለዘ፡ ይትፈጥሩ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ለዐመፃ፡ ይኩኑ፡

i18n.en: And the father said: Do not speak this word to them, for they will hear and join with those who lead astray; their hearts will incline to evil — they will not understand.

paragraphs.text: ወአርመመ፡ አብራም፡ እምነ፡ ቅድመ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወኢነግሮ፡ ካዕበ፡ ካልአ፡ ቃለ፡ በእንተ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ጣዖታት፡ እስመ፡ ይፈርህ፡ ያሰትፍዕ፡ ለታራ፡ አቡሁ፡

i18n.en: And Abram held his peace before his father, and spoke no further word to him concerning the idols — for he feared to grieve Terah his father.

paragraphs.text: ወበአርብዓ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በኃምስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ አብራም፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ሰራ፡ ወለተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡

i18n.en: And in the fortieth jubilee, in the second week, in the seventh year of it, Abram took to himself a wife whose name was Sarai, the daughter of his father, as a wife.

paragraphs.text: ወአሮን፡ እኁሁ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በሳድስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለሰብዕ፡ ሰሙን፡ ለለ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ካልእ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሳብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሎጥ፡

i18n.en: And Haran his brother took to himself a wife in the third year of the third week of this fortieth jubilee; and she bore him a son in the seventh year of this week, and he called his name Lot.

paragraphs.text: ወቆመ፡ አብራም፡ በሌሊት፡ በዕለት፡ ሳድስ፡ ለሳብዕ፡ ወርኅ፡ ከመ፡ ያውዕያ፡ ቤታ፡ ለጣዖታት፡ ወአውዐየ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘያአምር፡

i18n.en: And Abram arose by night, on the new moon of the seventh month, to burn the house of the idols; and he burned everything that was in the house, and no one knew.

notes.official: Abram burns down the house of idols — the EARLIEST EXTANT TEXT of the Abraham-iconoclasm-fire tradition. Cross-corpus to Apoc. Abr. 1-8 + Gen Rab 38:13 + Qur'an Sura 21:51-71.

paragraphs.text: ወተንሥኡ፡ በሌሊት፡ ለማድኅኖ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ፡ እምነ፡ ማእከለ፡ እሳት፡

i18n.en: And they arose in the night, and sought to save their gods from the midst of the fire.

paragraphs.text: ወአሮን፡ ቆመ፡ ለማድኅኖ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወአቀደ፡ ቦቱ፡ እሳት፡ ወተውሕጠ፡ በውስተ፡ እሳት፡ ወሞተ፡ በዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡ ቅድመ፡ ታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ ወቀበርዎ፡ በዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡

i18n.en: And Haran rushed in to save them; and the fire took hold on him, and he was burned in the fire, and he died in Ur of the Chaldees before Terah his father — and they buried him in Ur of the Chaldees.

notes.official: Haran dies trying to rescue the idols — this 'Haran burned in the fire' detail becomes in later tradition (rabbinic + Islamic) the 'Abraham cast into the furnace' tradition (with Nimrod as the casting agent).

paragraphs.text: ወወፅአ፡ ታራ፡ እምነ፡ ዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡ ውእቱ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ለሐዊር፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ወምድረ፡ ከንዓን፡ ወኀደረ፡ ምድረ፡ ካራን፡ ወኀደረ፡ አብራም፡ ምስለ፡ ታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ ካራን፡ ክልኤተ፡ ሰሙናተ፡ ዘዓመታት፡

i18n.en: And Terah went forth from Ur of the Chaldees — he and his sons — to go into the land of Lebanon and into the land of Canaan; and he dwelt in the land of Haran. And Abram dwelt with Terah his father in Haran two weeks of years.

paragraphs.text: ወበሳድስ፡ ሰሙን፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፰፪፡ በሳድስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ቆመ፡ አብራም፡ በሌሊት፡ ለዕለት፡ ሐዲስ፡ ለሳብዕ፡ ወርኅ፡ ለነጻሮ፡ ኮከብ፡ እምነ፡ ሰርክ፡ እስከ፡ ነግህ፡ ለመጠን፡ ይሬእ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ነገር፡ ለዓመቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ዝናማት፡ ወቆመ፡ ባሕቲቱ፡ ወይኔጽር፡

i18n.en: And in the sixth week, in the fifth year of it, Abram sat up through the night — on the new moon of the seventh month — to observe the stars from evening unto morning, in order to see what the character of the year would be with regard to the rains; and he was alone and observed.

paragraphs.text: ወቦአ፡ ቃል፡ ውስተ፡ ልቡ፡ ወይቤ፡ ኵሎ፡ ትእምርቶሙ፡ ለከዋክብት፡ ወትእምርቶሙ፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ወትእምርቶሙ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ኵሉ፡ በእደ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለምንት፡ አንሰ፡ አንተ፡ ምስለ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ የኀሥሥ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ለርእስ፡ የብለትኒ፡ ጊዜ፡ ለቀርብታ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይከውን፡ ቅርብታ፡ ወአንተ፡ ለክፍሉ፡ ለፍቅሩ፡ ቦቱ፡ ይክል፡ ኵሎ፡

i18n.en: And a word came into his heart, and he said: All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the sun and of the moon, are all in the hand of the Lord. Why do I search them out? If he wills, he causes it to rain in the morning and the evening; and if he wills, he withholds — and all things are in his hand.

paragraphs.text: ወጸለየ፡ በውእቱ፡ ሌሊት፡ ወይቤ፡ አምላኪየ፡ አምላኪየ፡ አምላከ፡ ልዑል፡ አንተ፡ ባሕቲትከ፡ አምላኪየ፡ ወአንተ፡ ፈጠርከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወግብረ፡ እደዊከ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ወኪያከ፡ ወመለኮተከ፡ ኀረይኩ፡

i18n.en: And he prayed that night, and said: My God, my God, God Most High — you alone are my God. You have created all things, and all things that are are the work of your hands — you and your dominion have I chosen.

paragraphs.text: አድኅነኒ፡ እምነ፡ እደ፡ መናፍስት፡ እኩያን፡ ዘይሥልጡ፡ በልብየ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ለስሕተተ፡ ወአስተአተት፡ ቅድሜየ፡ ዘይከውን፡ ለሙስና፡ ወአንሰ፡ ኪያከ፡ ኬብር፡ ወንሕነ፡ ኬብር፡ ዘርእየ፡ እምድኅሬየ፡

i18n.en: Deliver me from the hands of the evil spirits who have dominion over the thoughts of the heart of men, and let them not lead me astray, my God; but you and your seed establish me forever — and let me not go astray from now on and forever.

notes.official: Abram's anti-Mastema prayer: 'My God, El Elyon... deliver me from the evil spirits who rule the thoughts of human hearts.' Explicit invocation against the Mastema-figure introduced at 10:8.

paragraphs.text: ኢትኅድግ፡ ኪያየ፡ እምነ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዐመፃ፡ እንተ፡ ኪያየ፡ ለስሕተተ፡ ድኅረ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ርኩሰ፡ ለክፍሉ፡ ለሥሥዓት፡ ኒሁ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቅዱስ፡ አንፍሕ፡ በላዕለ፡ ልብየ፡ ወአንፍህ፡ በላዕለ፡ ልብየ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወልባት፡

i18n.en: And he said: Shall I return to Ur of the Chaldees who seek my face — that I return to them — or am I to remain here in this place? The path before you make straight by my hand; that I may do — and that I may not walk in the deceitful conjurations of my heart. May it cease, my God.

paragraphs.text: ምንተ፡ እትሐወር፡ ካዕበ፡ መንገለ፡ ዑር፡ ዘከለዳዊያን፡ እለ፡ የኀሥሡ፡ ገጽየ፡ እመ፡ እትገብእ፡ ኀቤሆሙ፡ አው፡ ይዕቅቡኒ፡ በዝንቱ፡ መካን፡ ወአንተ፡ ሤሞ፡ ለመጠን፡ ግዕዘ፡ ሠናይ፡ ቅድሜየ፡

i18n.en: Send forth your spirit upon your servant and his seed, that we may keep your commandments — and that we may not perish forever.

paragraphs.text: ወፈጸመ፡ ይትናገር፡ ወይጼሊ፡ ወእነ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ቃለ፡ ዘእግዚእ፡ ቦአ፡ ውስተ፡ ልቡ፡ ወይብል፡ ግዕዝ፡ እምነ፡ ምድርከ፡ ወእምነ፡ አዝማድከ፡ ወእምነ፡ ቤተ፡ አቡከ፡ ኀበ፡ ምድር፡ ዘአርእየከ፡ ወእገብር፡ ኪያከ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ዐቢይ፡

i18n.en: And he ceased from speaking and praying. And behold, the word of the Lord was sent to him through me, saying: Go forth from your land, and from your kindred, and from the house of your father, to a land which I shall show you — and I will make of you a great nation.

paragraphs.text: ወእባርከ፡ ኪያከ፡ ወአዐብየከ፡ ለስም፡ ወትኩን፡ ቡሩከ፡ በምድር፡ ወይትባረኩ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኪያከ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ አሕዛበ፡ ምድር፡ ወአባርክ፡ ለዘ፡ ይባርከከ፡ ወእትኰነን፡ ለዘ፡ ይረግመከ፡

i18n.en: And I will bless you, and I will magnify your name; and you shall be a blessing in the earth; and in you shall all families of the earth be blessed. And I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse those who curse you.

paragraphs.text: ወእከውን፡ ለከ፡ አምላከ፡ ወወልድከ፡ ወውሉደ፡ ውሉድከ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘርእከ፡ ኢትፍራህ፡ እምነ፡ ይእዜ፡ ወእስከ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ አንሰ፡ አምላክከ፡

i18n.en: And I will be a God to you, and to your son, and to your son's son, and to all your seed. Fear not — from now on and unto all the generations of the earth I am your God.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላክ፡ ለነ፡ አርኅው፡ አፋሁ፡ ወዕዘናቲሁ፡ ከመ፡ ይስማዕ፡ ወይትናገር፡ ቃለ፡ በልሳኑ፡ ዘይትከሠት፡ እስመ፡ አጸሙ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ ዕለተ፡ ምውዓ፡ ለሰብእ፡

i18n.en: And the Lord God said to me: Open his mouth and his ears, that he may hear and speak with his lips in the tongue which has been revealed — for it had ceased from the mouth of all the sons of men from the day of the overthrow.

notes.official: The angel of the presence opens Abram's mouth and ears and teaches him Hebrew — 'the language of creation that had been forgotten' at Babel. The EARLIEST EXTANT TEXT for the Hebrew-as-original-language tradition.

paragraphs.text: ወአርኀውኩ፡ አንሰ፡ አፉሁ፡ ወዕዘናቲሁ፡ ወከናፍሪሁ፡ ወአኀዝኩ፡ እትናገር፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ዕብራይስጥ፡ በልሳነ፡ ፍጥረት፡

i18n.en: And I opened his mouth and his ears and his lips, and I began to speak with him in Hebrew — in the tongue of the creation.

notes.official: Abram reads the books of his fathers (the Enochic + Noachic library) — foundational text for the Jubilees-distinctive pre-Mosaic-library tradition. Cross-corpus to the heavenly tablets motif.

paragraphs.text: ወነሥአ፡ መጻሕፍቶሙ፡ ለአበዊሁ፡ ወእመንቱ፡ ጽሑፋን፡ ዕብራይስጥ፡ ወወሰዶሙ፡ ወአኀዘ፡ ይትመሀሮሙ፡ እምነ፡ ይእዜ፡ ወአርአይክዎ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘይትሐጥት፡ ቦቱ፡ ወአንበቦ፡ ስድስተ፡ አውራኀ፡

i18n.en: And he took the books of his fathers, and they were written in Hebrew; and he transcribed them, and began to study them from then onward; and I made known to him all that he could not understand, and he studied them through the six rainy months.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤሎ፡ ለታራ፡ አቡሁ፡ አንሰ፡ እትከሐድ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ካልእ፡ ሐቤየ፡ እንተ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ይትከሠት፡ ቅድሜየ፡ እምነ፡ መንገለ፡ ኪያሃ፡ ካልአ፡ ኀቤየ፡ ለግዕዝ፡ ወአንተ፡ አባ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ምስሌየ፡

i18n.en: And he said to Terah his father: I am going forth toward another land which will be shown me, away from this one — toward a land far from here — to go to it. Come with me, my father.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤሎ፡ ታራ፡ ሖር፡ ዘውእቱ፡ ሰላም፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ወእመ፡ ትሬእይ፡ ምድረ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለግዕዝ፡ ብሔር፡ ለዕዝነ፡ ለነ፡ ወእባእ፡ ምስሌከ፡ ካዕበ፡ ወእነሥእ፡ ኪያከ፡ ናኮር፡ እኁከ፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡ መካን፡ ለርእስ፡ ቤትየ፡ ወትሰዶ፡ ምስሌከ፡

i18n.en: And Terah said to him: Go, my son, in peace. If you see a land good in your eyes for dwelling, then come back and take me with you; and take Nahor your brother with you, with his wife — for behold, the place of my dwelling-house has been laid waste — and bring him with you.

paragraphs.text: ወይቤሎ፡ አብራም፡ ለታራ፡ አባ፡ አንሰ፡ እትፈትህ፡ መንፈስየ፡ መንገለ፡ ምድር፡ ግዕዝ፡ ብሔር፡ ወእትገባእ፡ ኀቤከ፡ ካዕበ፡ በሰላም፡

i18n.en: And Abram said to Terah: My father, I will set out for the land toward which I am to go; and I will return again to you in peace.

paragraphs.text: ወወፅአ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ሎጥ፡ ወውስቴታ፡ ለመጠን፡ ሐጊ፡ ዘምድረ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ብሔር፡ ወኀደሮሙ፡ መንገለ፡ ሴኬም፡ ለመጠን፡ ዘይከውን፡ ቤተ፡ መካን፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ቅድመ፡ ዘኮኖ፡ ብእሲ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድረ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ብሔር፡ ለዓመት፡ አሐቲ፡

i18n.en: And Lot went forth with him into the land of his journeying; and they came into the land of Canaan, and they dwelt in the territory of Shechem — for the land that should be a dwelling-place upon the earth was before them; and the Canaanite was then in the land.
